title: Widen at fixed depth (ASPECT_RATIO 64->96)
description: Kept DEPTH=8, raised ASPECT_RATIO 64->96 so n_embd goes 512->768 and n_head 4->6, widening the model instead of deepening it; complements the DEPTH-only sweeps everyone else proposed this round.
reflection: val_bpb 0.998671 vs baseline 1.014027, a solid improvement (~1.5%) from a one-line width change. Confirms the baseline's actual built model (n_embd=512 via ASPECT_RATIO=64*DEPTH=8) was under-widened relative to the GPTConfig dataclass's own defaults (n_embd=768, 12 layers). Since five other agents this round all tested DEPTH alone (holding ASPECT_RATIO fixed), width was the genuinely untested axis, and it paid off. Next round: try combining a slightly increased DEPTH with this wider ASPECT_RATIO, or push ASPECT_RATIO further (768 already matches the dataclass default width -- worth checking if e.g. 112-128 keeps helping or hits a wall given the fixed 5-min budget's step-count tradeoff).
